description:
CAD-1K Open v2 - 1,018.1229 Hours
	

509 end-to-end, single-display Windows CAD task recordings across seven CAD software families.
Each task contains:

task_desc.json - task prompt, application, reference-input paths, and expected deliverables
input_files/ - reference inputs named input.ext or input_N.ext
output_files/ - submitted CAD deliverables and supplemental outputs named output.ext or output_N.ext
rubrics.json - task-specific evaluation criteria
